description_en: Associates a file as an attachment of a work item. This is the third step of uploading an attachment to a work item. For the first two steps, refer to the description of the GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta (obtain the information for uploading attachments to work items) operation
description_zh: 将文件作为工作项的附件，这是工作项上传附件的第三步，前两步可以查看 GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta(获取工作项上传附件的信息) 接口的描述
name: WorkitemAttachmentCreate

parameters.help_en: The enterprise ID, also known as the organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The work item ID, which is the same as workitemId. It is the unique identifier of a work item
parameters.help_zh: 工作项id，同workitemId，工作项唯一标识
parameters.name: workitem_identifier

parameters.help_en: The file key, which corresponds to the dir value returned by the GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta operation. The file must have been uploaded successfully
parameters.help_zh: 文件key，对应GetWorkitemAttachmentCreatemeta接口返回的dir值，前提是已经成功上传完文件
parameters.name: file_key

parameters.help_en: The original full name of the uploaded file
parameters.help_zh: 上传的文件原始完整名称
parameters.name: original_filename

errorCode.description_en:
If success is false, a business error code is returned.
 
If success is true, an empty value is returned.
errorCode.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误码；
 
当success为true，返回空值。

errorMessage.description_en:
If success is false, a business error message is returned.

If success is true, an empty value is returned
errorMessage.description_zh:
当success为false，返回业务错误信息；

当success为true，返回空值

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique ID for troubleshooting purposes
requestId.description_zh: 请求id，每次请求都是唯一值，便于后续排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
success.description_zh: true 接口调用成功，false 接口调用失败
